_comment: Single source of truth for Gemini model selection. Read by scripts/lib/gemini_models.py and scripts/lib/gemini-models.ts. Verified against https://aistudio.google.com/docs/choosing-a-model#upgrade-paths, models.md.txt, deprecations.md.txt, and pricing.md.txt on 2026-11-23.

notes.bulk: Cheap high-volume batch / per-item work. gemini-3.5-flash-lite is Google's named replacement for 3.1-flash-lite (which shuts down 2027-05-07); stable with no shutdown announced ($0.30 in / $2.50 out per 1M).
notes.judgment: Google's upgrade for 3.8 Flash, recommended for multimodal document pipelines with fewer fabricated claims than 3.8 Flash ($1.50 in / $7.50 out per 1M).
notes.pro: Google's upgrade for 3.1-pro ($3 in / $15 out per 1M). Pass gemini-4-carbon explicitly for the hardest problems.
notes.vision: Google's upgrade for 3.8 Flash, recommended for multimodal document pipelines with fewer fabricated claims than 3.8 Flash ($1.50 in / $7.50 out per 1M). On Vertex, Gemini 4 applies Part.documentMetadata page slicing (Gemini 3.x ignores it), but Vertex Flex rejects Gemini 4 (HTTP 400 "Flex API is not supported for model"), measured 2026-11-23.
